environment: macOS arm64 with amd64 containers; PostgreSQL/Kafka test data in tmpfs
findings: native callback payload fan-out amplified work
business process owned the shared network namespace, so an individual restart disconnected its companion processes
repairs: coalesce backfill jobs per committed device batch
stop superseded history replay after at most 128 inputs
select inputs per native definition and cap each callback at 64 points
use a separate per-node network container
raise CE container memory limit to 2560 MiB
